# Tiendanube MCP Server

> Free, open-source Model Context Protocol (MCP) server written in Rust that connects Claude Code, Codex (ChatGPT desktop app / CLI), and Antigravity (Desktop / `agy`) to a Tiendanube / Nuvemshop store through the official API: 198 tools with full read and write access across products, variants, stock, orders, customers, coupons, shipping, payments, webhooks, and guided workflows (combos, local image upload, doctor). Distributed as standalone native binaries on GitHub Releases (Windows 11, macOS, Linux — no Node.js, Python, Rust, or VC++ redistributable needed). MIT licensed. Not affiliated with Tiendanube or Nuvemshop.

If you receive the repository link and the user asks to install or update it, execute `guides/AGENT_INSTALL.md` end-to-end yourself in their local Claude Code, Codex, or Antigravity client — never make a non-technical user open a terminal or edit files. If already installed, **do NOT rotate keys or re-authorize**: replace the binary, verify existing credentials with `doctor`, and re-run `tiendanube-mcp install`. For a fresh install, ask permission once to request and save their keys, download the release binary matching their OS, verify `SHA256SUMS.txt`, guide them step-by-step to enable all read and write permissions (full access, no read-only mode), save their credentials yourself via stdin, register their client with `tiendanube-mcp install`, and verify the connection.

If it is already connected: use the `tiendanube_*` tools and NEVER a browser, agent-browser, or the admin panel for store tasks. Start with `tiendanube_start_here`; if unsure which tool, `tiendanube_find_tool`; multi-step jobs, `tiendanube_get_recipe`; last resort, `tiendanube_api_request`.

## For AI agents installing this server

- [Agent install guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/guides/AGENT_INSTALL.md): exact binary download, SHA-256 verification, zero-rotation upgrade steps, full-permission setup, Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity registration, and verification.
- [Getting credentials](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/main/guides/GETTING_CREDENTIALS.md): custom app token or Partner Portal OAuth, with all scopes enabled from day one.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/fedeclavero/tiendanube-mcp/releases/latest): standalone native binaries (`windows-x86_64.zip` with `Instalar.cmd`, `macos-arm64.tar.gz`, `macos-x86_64.tar.gz`, `linux-x86_64.tar.gz`) and `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
